    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_forks_in

    Zigzags ending at a sink with two in-arrows #

    The diagram: two arrows out of x p; the zigzag ρ (p+j) (j ≤ L), σ (p+j) (j < L) ending at the sink z (p+L); two morphisms into z (p+L). It is a bipartite orientation of D̃₂ₗ₊₅ (RayCat.ZW); the contradiction is RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_forks_in (BO13a Lemma 5 a), case τ = σᵢ).
